name: Runner Extras - DotNet Platform Refusal
brief: Issue #3222: a Windows-only .NET library reached through an instance or static DotNet member call (not only a constructor) fails with the runner's named dotnet-platform-unsupported refusal, never BC's bare 'type initializer' message.
description: Runner-specific by construction: on a Windows service tier every call here succeeds, so the claim 'the runner refuses it by name' cannot be a corpus test. target=OnPrem because the static-call and control tests declare DotNet types (AL0296 on Cloud).
